## What's new in v0.2.4

- Added browser keyboard shortcuts for creating, closing, reopening, and switching tabs; stopping and reloading pages; finding text; scrolling; printing; saving; fullscreen; and developer tools.
- Fixed the address bar and navigation history updating on sites such as YouTube when pages change without a full reload.
- Video fullscreen now fills the entire screen and restores the previous browser window mode when exited. F11 browser fullscreen keeps the tabs and address bar visible.
- Extra tabs now appear in a numbered overflow menu when the tab bar fills. Hover or click the counter to select a hidden tab; the layout adapts when the window is resized.
- Middle-click a tab to close its page. Closing one page of a split leaves the other open as a normal tab.
- Right-click a tab and choose **Close page** to close that specific page, including background tabs and individual split pages.

## Windows installers

Choose either the **EXE setup** or **MSI installer** from the assets below. Both install AuraView v0.2.4 for Windows x64.
